class Runner { async inOrder(items, step, {reason}) { for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await client.put(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await audit.save(item);
} } }

new Runner().inOrder([], async (value) => {}, {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
